knownConsequences.description: GAP 1: server/src/routes/audits/packs.routes.ts GET /packs and GET /packs/:id apply no publication_status filter by default and no capability check (only write routes call requireAdmin). Any authenticated org member — not just pack authors/admins — can browse and read draft/in-review pack content today. Ready-to-apply diff exists (ICR-1) but is outside this lane's lease.

GAP 2: ISO_27001_PRESET (src/components/Audit/auditPresets.ts:47-145) is static frontend data reachable by default through the legacy Audit Orchestrator wizard (MODULE_AUDITS: 'open'), with no audit_norm_sources row and no rights check, because it feeds the legacy write path and never reaches packValidator. Standard-naming-as-content, not reproduced clause language, but still brands a client deliverable as an 'ISO 27001 readiness audit' outside the rights kernel. Fix is blocked on a Product decision (Section 1, item 2 of the AUD-POL-001 decision packet).

What genuinely remains: the third amendment control is unmet — the independence detector is implemented and scheduled (auditIndependenceDetectorJob.ts:67, Scheduler.ts:891) but fenced default-OFF (Scheduler.ts:38), which is a deployment act, not repository state; the owner has not signed off that the restricted-scope implementation as built satisfies AMD-AUD-RIGHTS-001; and no test was replayed at this SHA, because the recorded G2 command would now execute zero tests under the destructive-fixture opt-in guard at auditPackRights.realdb.test.ts:70-77.
